rows.grounds: asatya = not true; neuter nominative singular
kuleśvarī = mistress of Kula; vocative singular

items.question: How can the untrue become true for Kaulikas?
premises: Untrue things may be true for Kaulikas.
items.inference: The Kaula view can transform apparent untruth into truth.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic role of asatyam is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: Even what is untrue may be true for the Kaulikas, O Kuleshvari.
